'''Tythe''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Tythe system/Legends|Tythe system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], near [[Nelvaan/Legends|Nelvaan]].

==History==
{{Quote|Revealed, the importance of Tythe is. To draw into the Outer Rim additional Jedi.|Yoda to Mace Windu|<ref name="LOE" />}}
The planet was once lush as [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], until it became headquarters of [[LiMerge Power/Legends|LiMerge Power]]. LiMerge stripped the planet of its resources, seeking to exploit the natural [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] reserves. Later, the company abandoned the planet, leaving behind a desert wasteland, vegetation found only in its red-water lakes.

Tythe was of little tactical value other than as a jump point. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] garrisoned the planet, but it was taken by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], as a feint to distract Republic forces away from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], in preparation for the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]. After a [[Battle of Nelvaan|quest on]] [[Nelvaan/Legends|Nelvaan]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] led an assault against the Confederate forces over Tythe, in an attempt to apprehend [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. Their starfighters barely made it past the orbital defenses, and once inside the LiMerge headquarters building, Dooku began taunting the two Jedi. Anakin gave into his rage and brought the LiMerge headquarters toppling down on his head, though Dooku escaped to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Kenobi and Skywalker left Tythe when they were recalled to Coruscant to assist in its defense from [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] attack.
